shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dropped over 3.6% below $71,000, with sentiment showing "Extreme Fear".
Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced nearly $3 billion in outflows, turning year-to-date flows negative.

Ethereum ETFs recorded strong weekly inflows of $2.85 billion, showing institutional interest.
